caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed bonnet rendered in shades of beige and light brown. The bonnet features a rounded crown formed by evenly spaced, vertical ribbed sections that curve backward, giving a structured shape. At the base of the crown, there is a gathered section that transitions into a wide, soft collar or neck flap that hangs down loosely. The gathered fabric and ribbing are carefully delineated with fine lines to indicate texture and material, possibly a woven or quilted cloth. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, focusing attention entirely on the centrally positioned bonnet. The lower right corner of the drawing includes the faint inscription “E. GAUSSER.”
title: Quaker's Baby Bonnet
